reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) strongly supports the creation of heterogeneous microstructures and strength-ductility enhancement via cryo-rolling and annealing in specific EHEAs, but none of the evidence involves the (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 alloy or addresses the preservation of caloric properties, leaving the key premise of caloric response preservation and the transferability of the mechanism entirely unsupported.
premises: Cryogenic rolling followed by annealing can create a refined, heterogeneous lamellar microstructure in HEAs
Such a heterogeneous microstructure enhances strength and ductility simultaneously
The thermomechanical processing does not alter the chemical composition or phase transformation mechanism responsible for the caloric effect
The specific alloy system (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 will respond to cryo-rolling and annealing similarly to the cited EHEAs
